live_ar.privacy: Camera stays on your device; nothing is recorded or uploaded. Starting downloads body and hand tracking from jsDelivr and Google. Experimental silhouette sizing and hand occlusion; no cloth simulation. Visual preview only, not a fit measurement.
live_ar.permission: Choose Start camera, then allow camera access. Keep your shoulders and upper torso in view.
live_ar.loading: Loading garment and on-device tracking. Please wait.
live_ar.body_missing: Bring your shoulders and upper torso into view. Face the camera in good light.
live_ar.tracking: Live preview active. Your selected size changes jacket proportions. Face forward and move slowly.
live_ar.denied: Camera blocked. Allow access in browser settings, then restart the camera.
live_ar.unsupported: Live AR needs HTTPS and camera support. Try Safari or Chrome, or use photo try-on.
live_ar.runtime_error: Preview could not load or continue. Check your connection, close other camera apps and restart the camera.
live_ar.paused: Camera stopped while this page was in the background. Choose Start camera to resume.
live_ar.variant_unavailable: This option is unavailable. Choose another option or return to the product page.
live_ar.cart_error: Could not add this item. Check your connection and try again.
live_ar.added: Added to your cart. Continue your preview or choose View cart.
live_ar.setup: Live AR: select a product, transparent garment image and supported variant IDs. Map only variants matching the garment and color.
live_ar.demo: Sample jackets · preview only, not for purchase
live_ar.qr_instructions: Scan this code with your phone camera and open the link. The selected jacket opens on your phone. Tap Start camera, allow access, and keep your shoulders and upper torso visible.
live_ar.qr_privacy: Try-on runs on your phone. Camera video is not sent to this computer. Your phone has its own cart. A password-protected store may ask you to unlock it first.
live_ar.qr_alt: Scan to open this jacket in mobile try-on
live_ar.qr_unavailable: Phone handoff needs a public HTTPS storefront page. Open the Shopify storefront preview in a separate tab to create a scannable code. A localhost address works only on this computer.
live_ar.qr_error: Could not create the phone code. Check your connection and try again.
live_ar.asset_error: The jacket image could not load. Reload this storefront preview, then restart the camera.
live_ar.camera_error: The camera stopped or could not start. Check camera access and close other camera apps, then retry.
live_ar.module_error: The preview software could not download. Check your connection and reload this page.
live_ar.model_error: Body tracking could not initialize. Check your connection, reload the page and retry.
live_ar.frame_error: Body tracking stopped while reading a camera frame. Restart the camera. If this repeats, reload the page.
live_ar.arms_missing: Upper-body preview active. Sleeves follow visible arm joints; hidden joints use estimated positions.
live_ar.size_demo_note: Demo sizing only: illustrative measurements, not First MFG's size chart. Size choices change the visual preview and cannot be purchased.
live_ar.size_real_note: Experimental visual size preview; it does not guarantee physical fit. Available sizes use this jacket's configured chart.
live_ar.size_scan_note: Start the camera first. Stand upright in close-fitting clothing with your full head and heels visible. Follow the front and side instructions. Camera processing stays on your device; no captures or measurements are uploaded or saved.
live_ar.size_ready: Choose a size to change the preview, or enter your height for an experimental front/side size suggestion.
live_ar.size_start_camera: Start the camera first, then choose Suggest my size.
live_ar.size_front: Front capture: stand upright, face forward, keep head and heels visible and arms slightly apart. Hold still for two seconds.
live_ar.size_side: Front captured. Turn fully sideways, keep head and heels visible, and hold both forearms forward away from your torso. Hold still for two seconds. Face forward again for the jacket preview.
live_ar.size_timeout: A stable full-body view could not be captured. Check framing and lighting, then retry. No size was guessed.
live_ar.size_failed: The two views could not produce a usable estimate. Retry the scan.
live_ar.size_outside: No single size matches all estimated measurements in this chart. Check the product's size guide or ask the merchant for help.
live_ar.size_manual_active: Your selected size {selected} remains active. Choose Use suggested size to switch.
live_ar.size_auto_active: The preview is using suggested size {size}. You can choose a different size at any time.
live_ar.size_unavailable: The suggested size is unavailable for this jacket. Your current selection remains active.
live_ar.size_interrupted: Size scan stopped. Your selected size is preserved. Restart the camera and choose Suggest my size to retry.
live_ar.size_no_chart: Size preview and suggestions need an approved measurement chart for this product. Size buttons can still select available Shopify variants. Demo measurements are never applied to real products.
